description: Summarize any text or web page into a TL;DR, bullet points or a short paragraph, with the key takeaways. Pass the text itself or just a URL. Works on articles, docs, transcripts, emails and reports. Pay per call; ask the pricing tool for a quote.

language.description: Write the summary in this language. Default: the source's language.

max_words.description: Rough length limit for the summary. Default 120.

text.description: Text to process (first 12,000 characters are used). Use this or url.

url.description: A public web page to read instead of text, e.g. a news article or blog post.

name: summarize
title: Summarize text or a web page
